answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh ridge challenge every epoch. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed violet of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. The dawn is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal 6hljs.
